blocks.text: The holiday season in Manila just turned brighter as the Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone Festival of Lights officially launched last night at the Ayala Triangle Gardens. Curated by HBO Max for its upcoming HBO Original series, the evening brought a spellbinding experience to the heart of Makati. An exclusive VIP launch event on November 25 welcomed guests for a first look at the Hogwarts-inspired installation. Attendees explored interactive zones dedicated to each of the four Hogwarts houses, Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, and Slytherin, and participated in themed activities before gathering for a projection show synchronized to music, lights, and motion.
